task_fulfillment.rationale: Both requested Word deliverables are substantively present, and all ten listed numeric/rating requirements pass. Material correction is nevertheless needed: the email demands a fixed refund using an unverified fully-paid amount, while the report admits that uncertainty; the report also treats supply lead-time differences as confirmed launch-delay outcomes despite missing tooling and revalidation schedules. Retain the Vendrax recommendation, but make refund amounts conditional on payment records, show recovery-dependent financial scenarios, and distinguish quoted supply lead times from unverified launch recovery.
